definitions.explanation: Information or opinions about products, services, or businesses spread informally between people, either in person or through online review platforms.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}コミ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まった→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧。
examples.english: It spread by word of mouth.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}コミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant has high review ratings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧とき、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{口|くち}コミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When choosing a hotel for travel, I always refer to online reviews.

notes:
WRITING:
Written as {口|くち}コミ (mixed kanji and katakana). The コミ part is short for ⟦コミュニケーション→コミュニケーション：08425_komyunikeeshon⟧ (communication). Sometimes written entirely in katakana as クチコミ.

USAGE:
Originally referred to in-person word of mouth, but now overwhelmingly used to mean online reviews on platforms like Google Maps, ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ログ (Tabelog), and Amazon. The word carries a sense of peer-generated information as opposed to official advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}コミ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧: spread by word of mouth
- {口|くち}コミ⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧: review website
- {口|くち}コミ⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧: review rating
- {口|くち}コミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: write a review
